versos.grego: Διὸ ἀφέντες τὸν τῆς ἀρχῆς τοῦ Χριστοῦ λόγον ἐπὶ τὴν τελειότητα φερώμεθα, μὴ πάλιν θεμέλιον καταβαλλόμενοι μετανοίας ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων, καὶ πίστεως ἐπὶ Θεόν,

controles.web: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let us press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,
controles.kjv: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
controles.livre: Portanto deixemos os tópicos elementares da doutrina de Cristo, e prossigamos adiante até a maturidade, sem lançarmos de novo o fundamento da conversão de obras mortas, e da fé em Deus,

versos.grego: βαπτισμῶν διδαχὴν, ἐπιθέσεώς τε χειρῶν, ἀναστάσεώς νεκρῶν, καὶ κρίματος αἰωνίου.

controles.web: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
controles.kjv: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
controles.livre: da doutrina dos batismos, da imposição das mãos, da ressurreição dos mortos, e do juízo eterno.

versos.grego: καὶ τοῦτο ποιήσομεν, ἐάνπερ ἐπιτρέπῃ ὁ Θεός.

controles.web: This will we do, if God permits.
controles.kjv: And this will we do, if God permit.
controles.livre: E isso faremos, se Deus permitir.

versos.grego: Ἀδύνατον γὰρ τοὺς ἅπαξ φωτισθέντας γευσαμένους τε τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς ἐπουρανίου καὶ μετόχους γενηθέντας Πνεύματος Ἁγίου

controles.web: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
controles.kjv: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
controles.livre: Pois é impossível que os que uma vez foram iluminados, e experimentaram o dom celestial, e foram feitos participantes do Espírito Santo,

versos.grego: καὶ καλὸν γευσαμένους Θεοῦ ῥῆμα δυνάμεις τε μέλλοντος αἰῶνος,

controles.web: and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,
controles.kjv: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
controles.livre: e experimentaram a boa palavra de Deus, e os poderes do mundo futuro;

versos.grego: καὶ παραπεσόντας, πάλιν ἀνακαινίζειν εἰς μετάνοιαν, ἀνασταυροῦντας ἑαυτοῖς τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ παραδειγματίζοντας.

controles.web: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
controles.kjv: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
controles.livre: e então caíram, outra vez renová-los para o arrependimento, porque estão novamente crucificando o Filho de Deus para si mesmos, e o expondo à vergonha pública.

versos.grego: γῆ γὰρ ἡ πιοῦσα τὸν ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ἐρχόμενον πολλάκις ὑετόν καὶ τίκτουσα βοτάνην εὔθετον ἐκείνοις δι’ οὓς καὶ γεωργεῖται, μεταλαμβάνει εὐλογίας ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ·

controles.web: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it, and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;
controles.kjv: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
controles.livre: Pois a terra que absorve a chuva que com frequência vem sobre ela, e produz vegetação proveitosa para aqueles por quem e lavrada, recebe a bênção de Deus.

versos.grego: ἐκφέρουσα δὲ ἀκάνθας καὶ τριβόλους ἀδόκιμος καὶ κατάρας ἐγγύς, ἧς τὸ τέλος εἰς καῦσιν.

controles.web: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
controles.kjv: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
controles.livre: Contudo, se ela produz espinhos e abrolhos, é reprovada, e perto está da maldição. O seu fim é ser queimada.

versos.grego: Πεπείσμεθα δὲ περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀγαπητοί, τὰ κρείσσονα καὶ ἐχόμενα σωτηρίας, εἰ καὶ οὕτως λαλοῦμεν.

controles.web: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.
controles.kjv: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
controles.livre: Mas, ainda que estejamos falando assim, quanto a vós mesmos, amados, confiamos melhores coisas, relacionadas à salvação.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ἄδικος ὁ Θεὸς ἐπιλαθέσθαι τοῦ ἔργου ὑμῶν καὶ τῆς ἀγάπης ἧς ἐνεδείξασθε εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, διακονήσαντες τοῖς ἁγίοις καὶ διακονοῦντες.

controles.web: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
controles.kjv: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
controles.livre: Pois Deus não é injusto para se esquecer da vossa obra, e do amor que mostrastes para com o nome dele, quando servistes aos santos, e continuais a servir.

versos.grego: ἐπιθυμοῦμεν δὲ ἕκαστον ὑμῶν τὴν αὐτὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι σπουδὴν πρὸς τὴν πληροφορίαν τῆς ἐλπίδος ἄχρι τέλους,

controles.web: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
controles.kjv: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
controles.livre: Mas desejamos que cada um de vós mostre o mesmo empenho até o fim, para que a vossa esperança seja completa;

versos.grego: ἵνα μὴ νωθροὶ γένησθε, μιμηταὶ δὲ τῶν διὰ πίστεως καὶ μακροθυμίας κληρονομούντων τὰς ἐπαγγελίας.

controles.web: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherited the promises.
controles.kjv: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
controles.livre: a fim de que não vos torneis negligentes, mas sim, imitadores dos que pela fé e pela paciência herdam as promessas.

versos.grego: Τῷ γὰρ Ἀβραὰμ ἐπαγγειλάμενος ὁ Θεός, ἐπεὶ κατ’ οὐδενὸς εἶχεν μείζονος ὀμόσαι, ὤμοσεν καθ’ ἑαυτοῦ,

controles.web: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
controles.kjv: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
controles.livre: Pois Deus, quando prometeu a Abraão, como ninguém maior havia por quem jurar, jurou por si mesmo,

versos.grego: λέγων Εἰ μὴν εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω σε καὶ πληθύνων πληθυνῶ σε·

controles.web: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”
controles.kjv: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
controles.livre: dizendo: Certamente muito te abençoarei,  e muito te multiplicarei.

versos.grego: καὶ οὕτως μακροθυμήσας ἐπέτυχεν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας.

controles.web: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
controles.kjv: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
controles.livre: E assim, esperando pacientemente, Abraão obteve a promessa.

versos.grego: ἄνθρωποι γὰρ κατὰ τοῦ μείζονος ὀμνύουσιν, καὶ πάσης αὐτοῖς ἀντιλογίας πέρας εἰς βεβαίωσιν ὁ ὅρκος·

controles.web: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
controles.kjv: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
controles.livre: Pois as pessoas juram por alguém maior, e o juramento como confirmação é o fim de todo conflito entre elas.

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ περισσότερον βουλόμενος ὁ Θεὸς ἐπιδεῖξαι τοῖς κληρονόμοις τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τὸ ἀμετάθετον τῆς βουλῆς αὐτοῦ ἐμεσίτευσεν ὅρκῳ,

controles.web: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath;
controles.kjv: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
controles.livre: Assim Deus, querendo mostrar mais abundantemente a imutabilidade de sua intenção aos herdeiros da promessa, garantiu com um juramento;

versos.grego: ἵνα διὰ δύο πραγμάτων ἀμεταθέτων, ἐν οἷς ἀδύνατον ψεύσασθαι Θεόν, ἰσχυρὰν παράκλησιν ἔχωμεν οἱ καταφυγόντες κρατῆσαι τῆς προκειμένης ἐλπίδος·

controles.web: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
controles.kjv: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
controles.livre: a fim de que, por meio de duas coisas imutáveis, nas quais é impossível que Deus minta, nós, que buscamos refúgio, tenhamos encorajamento para agarrar a esperança posta diante de nós .

versos.grego: ἣν ὡς ἄγκυραν ἔχομεν τῆς ψυχῆς ἀσφαλῆ τε καὶ βεβαίαν καὶ εἰσερχομένην εἰς τὸ ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος,

controles.web: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil;
controles.kjv: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
controles.livre: Temos essa esperança  como uma segura e firme âncora da alma, que entra ao interior, além do véu,

versos.grego: ὅπου πρόδρομος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν εἰσῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς, κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ ἀρχιερεὺς γενόμενος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

controles.web: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
controles.kjv: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
controles.livre: onde, como precursor, Jesus entrou para nosso benefício, pois ele se tornou Sumo Sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
